questions.question: In the summary, what does the phrase "ex‑dividend" mean?
options: The stock is being sold without the right to receive the upcoming dividend
The market is closed for trading
The stock price is expected to rise sharply
questions.explain_en: Ex‑dividend means the shares are traded without the right to receive the dividend that will be paid soon.
questions.explain_zh: 「ex‑dividend」指的是股票在除息日交易，買家將無法取得即將發放的股息。
questions.news_title_en: TAIEX ends near flat as TSMC absorbs ex-dividend drag

questions.question: By how many points did the TAIEX close lower than its opening level on September 16?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the TAIEX closed at 45,624.98, down just 6.61 points.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要說明台指收盤比開盤低 6.61 點。
questions.news_title_en: TAIEX ends near flat as TSMC absorbs ex-dividend drag

questions.question: In the summary, what does the phrase "tight AI capacity" mean?
options: There is a shortage of AI production ability
questions.explain_en: It means there is not enough capacity to meet AI demand, indicating a shortage.
questions.explain_zh: 表示 AI 產能不足，需求大於供給，出現缺口。
questions.news_title_en: TSMC: AI demand strongest in 30 years, budget raised to 1.9x

questions.question: How much did TSMC increase its 2026 equipment budget compared to the late-2025 estimate?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the budget was lifted from 1.5 times to 1.9 times the late‑2025 estimate.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要說明預算從 1.5 倍提升到 1.9 倍，較 2025 年底的估計增加。
questions.news_title_en: TSMC: AI demand strongest in 30 years, budget raised to 1.9x

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "safeguard" mean?
questions.explain_en: Here "safeguard" means to protect something, such as retirees' assets.
questions.explain_zh: 此處的「safeguard」是指保護，例如保護退休族的資產。
questions.news_title_en: FSC promotes elderly-care trusts to safeguard retirees

questions.question: According to the summary, why does the FSC encourage banks to expand trust products?
options: To help seniors and give banks stable fee income
To reduce the number of banks
questions.explain_en: The summary says the policy aims to protect seniors' financial security and provides a stable fee‑income line for banks.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要指出，此政策旨在保護長者的財務安全，同時為銀行提供穩定的手續費收入來源。
questions.news_title_en: FSC promotes elderly-care trusts to safeguard retirees

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "appetite" mean?
questions.explain_en: Here "appetite" refers to the strong desire or interest of retail investors for active ETFs and income products.
questions.explain_zh: 此處的「appetite」指的是散戶對主動ETF與收益產品的強烈需求或興趣。

questions.question: How many new funds were launched in September according to the summary?
questions.explain_en: The summary states that five new funds were launched in September.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中提到九月份共推出了五檔新基金。

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "incurs" mean?
questions.explain_en: Here "incurs" means that missing the window will cause interest and possible penalties.
questions.explain_zh: 在此句中「incurs」指的是因錯過期限而產生利息和罰款。

questions.question: According to the summary, when must companies file their provisional income tax?
questions.explain_en: The summary states that the filing period is from Sept 1 to Sept 30.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明，企業必須在 9 月 1 日至 9 月 30 日之間完成申報。
questions.news_title_en: Provisional corporate income tax filing runs through Sept 30

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "capex" mean?
options: The rate at which prices increase over time
Money spent on buying equipment and building facilities
The total amount of a country's exports
questions.explain_en: In the text, "capex" refers to capital expenditures, i.e., spending on equipment, plants, and other fixed assets.
questions.explain_zh: 在文中，"capex" 指的是資本支出，也就是購買設備、建廠等固定資產的花費。
questions.news_title_en: Cathay-NTU lifts 2026 GDP forecast to 11.6% on AI export boom

questions.question: What is the new 2026 GDP growth forecast for Taiwan according to the Cathay-NTU team?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the forecast was raised from 10.1% to 11.6% for 2026.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明預測從 10.1% 提升至 2026 年的 11.6%。
questions.news_title_en: Cathay-NTU lifts 2026 GDP forecast to 11.6% on AI export boom
